facts.text: William Peace University requires every in-person undergraduate student to complete at least one internship as a key part of its curriculum.

sources.title: Students Find Confidence, Clarity, and Purpose Through Internships - William Peace University
sources.quote: Internships are a key part of the curriculum at William Peace University — in fact, every in-person student is expected to complete at least one.

facts.text: Under the Peace Pledge, William Peace University covers 100% of tuition for eligible North Carolina students.

sources.title: School Counselors - William Peace University
sources.quote: The Peace Pledge covers 100% of tuition for eligible North Carolina students.
